name: Lake Austin Spa Resort
positioning: All-inclusive lakeside spa resort of cottages and bungalows on the shores of Lake Austin in Texas Hill Country, built around a large spa specializing in aquatic treatments
best_for: Travelers wanting an all-inclusive spa and wellness retreat with meals, classes and lake activities in the rate
Guests who want time on the water, from kayaks and paddleboards to boat outings and water sports

facts.text: The resort is on the shores of Lake Austin in Texas Hill Country, approximately 30 minutes from downtown Austin.
It sits on a bend of the Colorado River, within a protected 21-mile stretch known as Lake Austin.
The resort grew from a historic lakeside lodge.
The building is made of local stone so it blends into the natural landscape.
Stays are all-inclusive: each overnight stay includes three meals daily, access to the LakeHouse Spa facilities, and wellness classes and lake activities.
All tips and gratuities are included in the stay.
Guests have direct lake access, with complimentary paddleboards, kayaks and hydrobikes.
The cottages are furnished with hand-picked linens, artwork and even antiques, with private front porches and hot tubs.
Lake View Bungalows have lake views.
The Lady Bird Johnson Cottage Suite is named in honor of Lady Bird Johnson, one of the resort's favorite guests.
StillWater serves breakfast, lunch and dinner in a lakeside setting.
Many of the ingredients come fresh from the resort's own gardens.

highlights.text: The spa covers 25,000 square feet and specializes in aquatic treatments.
One of the pools is housed inside a barn.
Hot Tub Cottages have a private meditation garden and an outdoor private hot tub.
Boat captains and water sports coaches help guests with boat charters, wake surfing, waterskiing and tubing.
The grounds offer hammocks, quiet nature trails, cooking classes and astrologer-led stargazing sessions.

considerations.text: The resort is approximately 30 minutes from downtown Austin.
WhataHotel notes the secluded location requires transportation to downtown Austin attractions.
Only a limited number of day spa reservations are available for guests not staying overnight.
